purpose: Upload the two .out BOMs into the same lead/project, run consolidation, then use the matching Central States-style shipper quote for comparison testing.
parserSafetyNotes: All quote detail rows use "Pieces" including zero-length EA rows, so parseCentralStates will not misread them as new quote lines.
Every BOM item has a unique mark and part/length combination across the two buildings to avoid grouped ambiguous matches.
The PDF uses the same Central States table structure as the Dave reference: 5 rows per page, Line/Product/Description/Qty/UOM/Unit Cost/Total Cost.
Quote rows are generated from the same rows as the two BOM files; expected comparison should be clean after consolidation if parser service is current.
